name: Bhogeshwari Pawar
tagline: I hunt threats, break things responsibly, and build the tooling that keeps systems and data safe.
about: I'm a final-year B.Tech CSIT (Cyber Security) student at Symbiosis Skills & Professional University, Pune, with four industry internships across SOC engineering, VAPT and privacy compliance.

I've found 20+ vulnerabilities on a live product, led an intern team to build an enterprise-level SOC lab from scratch, written SOAR playbooks, tuned IDS/IPS rules, and mapped technical controls to India's DPDPA 2023.

I use Python to automate the repetitive parts of security: log processing, risk scoring and compliance reporting. Outside work, I hunt logic flaws and authorization bypasses on HackerOne and solve labs on Hack The Box.
